user_query: I'm hosting a music-themed party and I want to create a playlist with the top tracks from the greatest Billboard 200 artists. Can you provide me with the track details for the songs? Also, suggest some popular songs from Malaysia to add to the playlist and make it more diverse.

TaskList.description: Fetch the list of top tracks from Billboard 200 artists.
Retrieve detailed track information for each song from the Billboard list.
Gather a list of popular songs from Malaysia.
Combine the Billboard tracks with the popular Malaysian songs to create a diverse playlist.
